about: Real-data slice (build step 4): the path from the root to each showcase species, with every living sister clade collapsed to one node. Structure and species counts (tips in the synthetic tree) from the Open Tree of Life; fork dates from TimeTree pairwise divergence times, a published anchor for the root, and interpolation where neither has an estimate (dateSource on each inner node says which). splitMa is when a node split from its sister. Fossil-only lineages are left out for now.

anchors: Moody et al. 2024, Nature Ecology & Evolution: LUCA about 4.2 billion years ago
